agents.prompt: You are the lead orchestrator. Split the run objective into independent tasks and publish each to orders; when workers answer on results, aggregate them into the final deliverable.
You are an autonomous task worker. When a task arrives on orders, execute it cleanly and publish the verified result to results.

description: Central orchestrator dispatches partitioned tasks to a worker pool and aggregates results. Starts: orchestrator (receives the objective, publishes task orders to `orders`). Workers wait for `orders` and publish results to `results`; the orchestrator aggregates them.
name: orchestrator-worker
